$comment: Model binaries are never committed. `pnpm models:fetch` downloads each remote entry into public/models/ and verifies its SHA-256, then copies the MediaPipe WASM runtime out of node_modules. earshot is handed these paths at runtime; nothing is ever fetched from a CDN by the app itself.

files.name: yamnet_classifier.tflite
files.purpose: Noise guard and machine-likeness check (521 AudioSet classes).

files.name: yamnet_embedder.tflite
files.purpose: 1024-dimensional embedding per window; the space profiles are learned in.

wasm.purpose: MediaPipe's WASM runtime, copied from the installed package so no CDN is involved.
